card3.title: AI Context Engine
card3.desc: Swiss Ephemeris precision meets AI. It doesn't just show the math; it speaks to you like a master astrologer, explaining what the data means for your life.
card3.quote: The curve dips smartly because Pluto is squaring your MC. This isn't bad luck—it's meant to break down outdated career structures so you can rebuild on a truer foundation next year. Protect your capital, don't force expansion.

card4.title: Astronomical Precision

page_client.calculation_desc1: We use the Swiss Ephemeris DE431 dataset to compute the precise coordinates of major planetary bodies at any given point in your life.
page_client.calculation_desc2: Instead of general horoscopes, the algorithm plots the geometric angles (aspects) between transiting planets and your natal chart. High-synchronicity transits (trines, sextiles) plot a rising score, while friction transits (squares, oppositions) plot a dip.
page_client.markers_desc1: The gold line is your overarching momentum trajectory. When it rises, external forces are generally supportive of expansion.
page_client.markers_desc2: Nodes along the curve indicate exact transit hits. Clicking a bright node provides AI-driven analysis of that specific year's astrological weather.

highest_point.title: Highest Point
highest_point.desc: Peak momentum year. The trajectory favors expansion, visibility, and capitalizing on established foundations.

lowest_point.title: Lowest Point
lowest_point.desc: Key friction year. Structural re-evaluation. A time for building internal resilience rather than external force.
